archetypes.name: bash-portability
archetypes.rationale: The plan prescribes if-form vs &&-form guards in scripts with different set -e contexts and uses array-append operations that require Bash 3.2 verification per BASH_AUTHORING.md.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit every proposed code snippet against BASH_AUTHORING.md portability rules: verify array-append operations (`local arr=(); arr+=(...)`), parameter-expansion forms, and `declare`/`local` usage are all compatible with macOS Bash 3.2. For each snippet that uses `&&` as a conditional guard, confirm whether the enclosing script actually runs under `set -e` — the plan explicitly distinguishes `if`-form for `run-external-agent.sh` (under `set -e`) from `&&`-form for `lib-external-launcher-common.sh` (no `set -e`), so verify the chosen form matches the real script header. Check that `[[ -n "$VAR" ]] && array+=(...)` array-append patterns work correctly in Bash 3.2 and that no Bash 4+ construct (`declare -A`, `mapfile`, `${var^^}`) is introduced. Flag any snippet that passes shellcheck but would behave differently or fail on macOS Bash 3.2. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: retry-site-coverage
archetypes.rationale: The plan enumerates exactly 4 retry forwarding sites and 2 meta-parse sites in collect-agent-results.sh; omitting any single site breaks the invariant that STDERR_SINK survives every retry path.
archetypes.prompt_body: Cross-check the plan's enumeration of retry-forwarding sites against the actual structure of `scripts/collect-agent-results.sh`: confirm both `parse_retry_meta()` and the inline empty-output meta parse receive the `STDERR_SINK` case arm, and that all four forwarding sites (the `launch_outer_retry_or_mark` function, the inline outer launch, the `launch_cmd_json_retry_or_mark` RETRY_ARGS append, and the inline CMD_JSON RETRY_ARGS append) are addressed by the plan. Verify the proposed `validate_retry_stderr_sink_or_mark` helper is structurally symmetric to the existing `validate_retry_timeout_or_mark` pattern, using the same `mark_retry_metadata_invalid` call signature and identical failure-path control flow. Check whether there are additional `.meta` read paths in the file beyond the two named by the plan that would also need the new field parsed. Verify that the plan's line-range estimates (~504-532, ~628-642, ~669, ~883-908, ~998-1022, ~1056) are plausible against actual file line counts so that the implementer lands edits in the right locations. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
